title: feat(spec): ComponentPropsMap gains a 'list-view' row — a page-embedded list view is judged as a list view; stored objectName / viewType convert to data / type (#22444)
body:
Fixes #22444

Clause-②: yes

Ruling C on #22444 (record `6100463199`, the maintainer's 「同意」), its spec half: a list view embedded on a page is judged as a list view, and the page carrier's own spelling `objectName` / `viewType` is refused by name and carried forward on stored nodes by an ADR-0087 D2 conversion. Dev session: `session_01Q5DmD3Wg7eTiagmd5p9rqf` (cloud dispatch from the `domain:spec#1` seat, claim `6238503560`).

## What changed

- **`ComponentPropsMap['list-view']`** (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `ListViewPageProps`). Every member is `ListViewSchema.shape`'s own schema object, and both of the list view's object-level checks are attached (`checkListViewCalendarVisualization`, `checkListViewChartBinding`). The two members the list overlay member declares instead, and nothing else:
  - `columns` optional: the overlay member's own spelling, `ListViewSchema.shape.columns.optional()`;
  - `options` judged per kind: the overlay member's own bag by reference, `VIEW_METADATA_MEMBERS.listOverlay.shape.options`. Each `options.KIND` is judged by that kind's block, and `options.grid` gets its existing guidance.
  - `objectName` / `viewType` are undeclared, and the row's guidance answers them by name. The guidance quotes the react tier's note for the same alias verbatim.
  - The row is not exported, for the reason `ListViewShapeSchema` is not: a top-level export would mint a def and duplicate every `ui/ListView` key in `authorable-surface/`. `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface` and `check:docs` are unchanged.
- **One prescription for both tiers.** `REACT_RETIRED_OVERLAY_PROPS.ListView`'s two entries moved, byte for byte, to a leaf module outside the `ui` barrel (`ui/list-view-retired-aliases.ts`). `react-blocks.ts` reads it there, and so does the row. The row cannot import `react-blocks.ts`, which reads `ComponentPropsMap` at module load. The published value of `REACT_RETIRED_OVERLAY_PROPS` is unchanged (`check:react-blocks` and `check:export-origins` are green).
- **D2 conversion `page-list-view-object-name-view-type-to-data-type`** (`conversions/registry.ts`, order 68, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`). On every page component of type `list-view` that `mapPageComponents` reaches:
  - `objectName: 'x'` becomes `data: { provider: 'object', object: 'x' }`;
  - `viewType` becomes `type`;
  - a redundant twin is deleted;
  - a conflict is left byte-identical and reported as a TODO: an alias beside a `data` source or a `dataSource.object` naming another object, a `viewType` beside a different `type`, or a non-string alias.
- **D3 entry** `page-list-view-object-name-view-type-retired` (`conversionIds` joins it to the conversion), plus its step-18 rationale fragment in `registry.ts.template` (order 101).
- **Census pins the new row trips, each classified instead of skipped:**
  - `page.zod.ts`: `PRINT_REFUSED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` gains `list-view` (it pages its rows, the `object-grid` reason). Before this, the type was refused in a print page as unknown vocabulary, so the accept set does not move.
  - The view-API-source refusal (`refused-shapes.ts` and the D3 entry `view-data-api-provider-retired`) now names `list-view` among the components whose `data` prop takes a view data source. The detector reads each row's `data` member, so it reaches a page `list-view` node for the first time with this row (contract review `6240571802`, ① item 8). The strings now name it.
  - The `z.unknown()` member ledger, the `requiredPermissions` census and the retired-prescription join each gained their `list-view` lines.
- The strictness ledger counts were regenerated (`gen:strictness-ledger`: `ui/` gains 1 strict site).

## Accept set, before → after

| door | before (`d9a749bae`) | after (this head) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PageSchema` / `PageComponentSchema` | accepts a `list-view` node with any `properties` | unchanged: accepts (the carrier stays an open record, maintainer ruling 2026-08-05) |
| component-props rule (`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, page save door) | `list-view` skipped as unregistered: 0 findings | judged by the row: `kanban.groupField`, `options.grid`, `properties.objectName`, `properties.viewType` are `component-props-unknown-key`, each naming the key |
| stored page row / artifact / installed package (data at rest) | loads as stored | the D2 conversion moves `objectName` / `viewType` to `data` / `type` on read |
| authoring funnel (`defineStack`) | n/a | does not replay the conversion (retired from the load path), so an author meets the refusal |

## Measured against a real producer

The external corpus `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` 4.0.1 (the published-pages fixture `packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/hotcrm-4.0.1-published-pages.artifact.json`, 7 pages in package 2) carries 4 page `list-view` nodes in the old spelling:
- without the conversion, the props rule reports 8 findings (each node's `objectName` and `viewType`);
- the conversion emits 8 `OS_METADATA_CONVERTED` notices and 0 TODOs;
- after the conversion, the rule reports 0 findings on those nodes. The row has no false positive on the converted real nodes (their rule-array `filter`, `{ field, order }` `sort` and string `columns` all pass).

In-repo producers of page `list-view` nodes: 0 in `packages/**` and `examples/**` outside test fixtures (control: the same grep hits `react-blocks.ts:292`).

- Consumers whose fixtures carry page `list-view` nodes, after a closure build: `@objectstack/objectql` `registry-installed-package-retired-page-declarations.test.ts` (8 passed), `@objectstack/service-package` (8 files, 119 passed), `@objectstack/cloud-connection` (50 files, 602 passed). All exit 0.
- New pins:
  - `spec/src/ui/component-list-view-row.test.ts`: the ruling's list, by-reference identity, the checks attached, one prescription for both tiers, `PageSchema` unmoved;
  - `spec/src/conversions/page-list-view-object-name-view-type-to-data-type.test.ts`: stored row → accepted by the row, notices, TODOs on conflict, not on the authoring funnel, idempotent, copy-on-write;
  - `lint/src/validate-component-props-list-view-22444.test.ts`: the findings at the gate, and through `runAuthoringRules`.
- **Ablation** (one shot, not kept): the map key was renamed to `list-view-ablated` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, then spec was rebuilt. The marker was present in `dist/` (proved by the run turning red). The lint pin went 5 failed / 3 passed: every flag case red, and the three contract-only cases still green, as expected with no row. Restore leg: `git checkout HEAD --`, blob `a5e4dbed97` equal to HEAD, rebuild, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exit 0, then the pin went 8/8 green.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (90 derived families, change set vs merge base `d9a749bae`), run at `945584a6`:
- 89 exited 0;
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (needs every package built), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI;

The `--ran` reconciliation reports 90 accounted, 89 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED. `check-adr-0087-registration`: "this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset". Separately, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reported 14/14 up to date after `gen:strictness-ledger`, and `check:dev-prereqs` exited 0. `origin/main` moved to `8259ea03` after this branch was cut. Those commits touch none of this PR's files, so no merge was taken.

## Patch round 1 (`e55aa1bf`)

- `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` (`--project repo`, Test Core) now passes 15/15. Each `list-view` alias prescription now ends with the house `os migrate meta` sentence, verbatim and in one literal, and the react-tier note moved one sentence earlier. The conversion docblock now says `--write` rewrites a source. spec `test:repo` 1115 passed, spec `test` 20989 passed, lint 6821 passed; 90/90 derived gates exit 0 (report `6241238026`).
- Contract review `6240571802` (on `86c001e7c`; the delta to `e55aa1bf` is the reorder above) holds ① and ③ and FAILs ② only, on the `Clause-②` arm. That item is the maintainer's, on #24219. This PR stays unarmed until #24219 is answered.

## Acceptance notes

- **The gate's tier is now `error`, not the "warning" the ruling text names.** Ruling item (1) says the row is lint-tier, "as every `ComponentPropsMap` row has been since #8691", with no new gate. Measured: `validate-component-props` emits `error` for every finding since #23147, at `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and at the runtime page save door (ruling record 6161173492). This PR adds no gate and changes no tier: the row takes the rule's tier, as every row does. So in practice an authored page source carrying `properties.objectName` / `viewType` on a `list-view` fails `os validate`, and a Studio, REST or MCP save of such a page is refused until it is rewritten. Stored rows load converted. The `Clause-②` arm follows the ruling (`yes (widening)`, minor). The seat may want the arm re-read on this fact (see the report's open question).
- **`columns` is optional whatever the binding.** The seat's note reads "optional under a `dataSource.view` binding". The row judges `properties` only and cannot see the node's `dataSource`. The overlay member's own difference is unconditional, and the list renderer draws a column-less list.
- **Differences from objectui's `ListViewPropsBag`** (`@object-ui/types` at the `.objectui-sha` pin `5e15928b46`), read as a reference only:
  - objectui makes the kanban block's `columns` optional and adds named refusals on its kanban / calendar / gallery / timeline blocks; this row keeps `ListViewSchema`'s blocks as declared;
  - objectui keeps its local toolbar flags and a passthrough tolerant face;
  - objectui attaches its own dataset-chart filter check.

  So a page kanban with a kanban block that omits `columns` passes objectui's face and draws `kanban.columns` required here.
- `.objectui-sha`, objectui, `PageSchema`'s accept set and `validate-component-props.ts` were not touched: the rule dispatches on map rows, and no dispatch change was needed.
